record.title_md: [Open Question (running time improvement for long hole detection)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.12273)

dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Question (running time improvement for long hole detection)
dossier_meta.statement_text: Can the running times of $O(|G|^{\ell+1})$ for detecting a long hole and $O(|G|^{20\ell+40})$ for detecting a long odd hole — both $|G|^{O(\ell)}$ — be substantially improved for fixed $\ell$?
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper gives algorithms with running time $|G|^{O(\ell)}$ for both long hole and long odd hole detection. Both problems are NP-hard when $\ell$ is part of the input, but whether the dependence on $\ell$ in the exponent can be reduced for fixed $\ell$ is left as an open question.
